title: Add product search by name
body:
## Summary

GET /api/products accepts q and returns products whose name matches.

## Changes

* list filters by q using a regular expression

## How to test

Call GET /api/products?q=Mouse.

verixa_should_cover: Search should be case insensitive (BUG: it is case sensitive)
q with regex characters such as ( must not crash the server (BUG: returns 500)
